does: Queues a request to put an entity into, or take it out of, narrative combat for the combat found by its guid: appends a 0x20-byte request (kind 2 or 3, entity, combat guid) to the combat system's request list at +0x318.

evidence.says: resolves the combat through eoc::CombatHelpers::LEGACY_GetCombatFromGuid, checks the combat StateComponent byte +0x75, then grows and appends to the array at +0x318 with kind (flag xor 1)+2
A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on (segments 36, 41, 42, 43), from 1 place, inside the function at +0x36A06xx
